title: Plan
description: Stage 0 output (plan.json), produced deterministically by harness/plan. Tonight's compo, research domain, size budget, constraint and the banned list assembled from the ledger. Also hosts the shared $defs (compo, date, hexColor) that every other schema references.

date.description: Night of the run, UTC, YYYY-MM-DD.

size_budget_bytes.description: Maximum byte size of the minified piece/index.html for tonight's compo (SPEC section 4). For constraint-night this is the constraint's own budget.

constraint.description: The single harsh limit for constraint-night (for example '1 KB', 'two colours', 'CSS only, no canvas'). Null for every other compo; required non-null for constraint-night.

domain.description: Research domain picked from config/domains.yml. On wildcard nights this is the literal 'wildcard' and the researcher chooses.

wildcard.description: True on the one-in-seven night where the researcher picks the domain.

banned.description: Everything later stages must avoid, assembled from the ledger and config/slop.yml.

techniques.description: Techniques used in the last 21 nights.

domains.description: Research domains of the last 10 nights.

palette_hexes.description: Palette colours from the last 7 nights. New palettes must keep a hue distance from these.

slop_patterns.description: Permanent slop list (SPEC section 6) plus retrospective additions from config/slop.yml.

boredom_override.description: True when the boredom drive forced a compo or technique family not used in 30 nights.

requires_audio.description: True when the piece must produce WebAudio output (audiovisual compo, or another compo that opts in). Enables the audio probe in stage 6.

seed.description: Seed for every weighted random pick in stage 0, so a plan is reproducible from the ledger plus this seed.

dry_run.description: workflow_dispatch dry-run input: run every stage but never publish. False on scheduled runs.

overrides.description: workflow_dispatch inputs as given. Each is null when not forced (always null on scheduled runs).

compo.description: Compo from the SPEC section 4 rotation.

hexColor.description: Colour as #RRGGBB. Either case is accepted; the harness lowercases before comparing or storing.
